title: Spelling check: 10 words from weeks 3 to 5
subject: English
source: Written for english/y2 lesson 40 (Spelling check sheet: 10 words from weeks 3 to 5)
intro: The teacher reads each word, then a sentence with it, then the word again. Write the word.

blocks.note: Read each word, a sentence, then the word again: 1 badge (I won a badge.) 2 huge (The tower is huge.) 3 city (We live in a city.) 4 knock (Knock on the door.) 5 write (I can write my name.) 6 table (Lay the table.) 7 camel (A camel has a hump.) 8 metal (A spoon is made of metal.) 9 pencil (Sharpen your pencil.) 10 because (I smiled because I was happy.)
